events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: After Attila

options.text: See if this [character] can be reasoned with.
It is time to be rid of this menace, once and for all.

events.text: [character] is dead. Rumors attribute the final blow of fate to everything from sudden internal bleeding to the blade of his latest wife. The [title] of the Huns has been buried in an unknown location, leaving a vacuum of power that his inner circle have each been trying to seize for themselves. It is [character] who rises from the chaos, claiming his right to inherit the legacy of the great warlord. How shall we treat with the [tribe] in light of this turn of fate?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Furry Spy

options.text: We will return this intruder with a warning.
I will adopt their pet monkey as my own.
Flay the beast and hang it from the city gates.

events.text: One evening as you prepare for a much-needed rest, you catch a movement out of the corner of your eye - a shadow. Lunging across the room, you wrestle a shadowy figure to the ground. A monkey! Its tiny satchel contains a number of confidential scrolls from the royal chamber, as well as military records. The writing on the furry spy's collar appears to be a form of [tribe].

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Hostile Garrison

options.text: It seems we have no choice.
We will never accept such a disgrace.

events.text: The [tribe] have a haughty new chief who is eager to expand the Tribe's power. Envoys inform you that he plans to place a permanent garrison in [city] to ensure peace. If we refuse, he will invade and install them by force. What is our reply?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: On the Edge

options.text: He can pick fights when he rules [rival].
The [tribe] have evaded me long enough.

requirements.label: Sylvan / Vigilant
tip: The leader must have one of: Sylvan (a character trait); Vigilant

options.text: This is an opportunity to gather intelligence.

events.text: Spies report that the death of [character] has left the [tribe] leadership in disarray, and that many question the legitimacy of his successor. "Now is the time to strike," remarks [character]. "The [tribe] stand on a precipice. All they need is a gentle push."

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Ongoing Alliance

options.text: Please accept this generous gift of gold.
We flatter the new leader of the [tribe].
Our alliance has come to an end.

events.text: With the end of [character]'s rule, our alliance with the [tribe] is in question. However, word has reached us that [character] is willing to extend our Alliance Tribe, but only if we show our willingness to honor this special relationship. What shall we tell him?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Renewing the Peace

options.text: We shall send him a gift of Money as a token of our friendship.
Let us humble ourselves before the new potentate.
This new [tribe] ruler is not so deserving of our good will. A mere Truce will suffice.

events.text: The [tribe] have a new ruler, [character], putting our diplomatic relations with the Tribe into doubt. Let us reach out to this newly coronated chieftain to ensure a renewal of our Peace.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: [tribe] Unity

options.text: Wait for [character] to make the first move.

events.text: The [tribe] stand, under [character], more unified than they have been in a generation, and those in [rival]'s borderlands grow uneasy. Debate divides the court. [character] wishes to mount a diplomatic expedition to bring [character] into the fold, while [character] insists that the only thing the [tribe] will respect is a show of force.
